items.quote: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
items.claim: Abraham performed the action of preparing and sending away Hagar with provisions at early morning, using the physical mechanism of placing supplies on her shoulder.
items.object: bread, bottle of water, Hagar, child
